description: The Transport for NSW Open Data Hub is the state transport agency's portal for datasets, APIs, geospatial files, interactive maps and visualisations for New South Wales, including Sydney. The home page offers dataset search and download, API connections with getting-started guides for real-time data, geospatial files with filters, contextual insight dashboards, and innovation challenges and co-design programmes. Coverage: public transport, roads and other transport in New South Wales. Format and access: downloads and API connections with getting-started guides. Licence and cost: free, with terms per dataset. Caveats: the home page does not list datasets, so contents and licences must be checked per item. It supports network flow, capacity planning and emergency response studies with real-time and static transport data. It relates to the GTFS specification and Transport Victoria open data in the catalogue.
